aboutPage.title: Built around better machining.
aboutPage.intro: We connect workshops with reliable industrial tooling and the practical knowledge to use it well.
aboutPage.p1: Axis Industrial was founded on a simple idea: machinists should be able to speak with suppliers who understand feeds, speeds, rigidity, runout, and the cost of a stopped spindle.
aboutPage.p2: We curate trusted products, answer application questions honestly, and stay accountable from quotation through delivery.
aboutPage.quote: “The right tool is the one that makes the whole process more predictable.”

items.title: Application first
items.text: We start with the material, machine, operation, and outcome—not a part number.

items.title: Quality that earns its place
items.text: Every line in our catalog must deliver credible value on the shop floor.

items.title: Support after delivery
items.text: Our relationship continues through setup, troubleshooting, and repeat supply.
